stem:
Aarav shines a torch at a glass mirror, a shiny steel spoon, and a dull cardboard sheet.

Which claim about reflection is correct?

options.text: The glass mirror and the shiny steel spoon change the direction of the light by reflection.
Only the glass mirror can reflect light; the shiny steel spoon cannot.
The torch beam changes direction toward the wall even when it passes beside the mirror.
No reflection occurs because there is no bright spot on another surface.

teacher.key_rationale: Reflection happens when light meets a mirror or shiny surface, so both the glass mirror and shiny steel spoon redirect the beam. Limiting reflection to glass only, claiming bending without hitting the mirror, or requiring a bright spot elsewhere are wrong.
